Action
Mr. Markey (for himself and Mr. Sanders) introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Finance
Bill Number
S. 5622
Bill Version
Introduced in Senate
(IS)
Short Title
Installing Clean Efficient Energy Hastens Our Transition Act of 2024
Full Title
To amend the Energy Policy Act of 2005 to establish an energy efficient appliance rebate program to provide rebates for the manufacturing, distribution, contracting, installation, and servicing of certain building electrification products and industrial heat pumps, and for other purposes.

Edward J. Markey(MA)

Bernard Sanders
(VT)
